name: HIL Coordinate Benchmark Datasets
framework_basis: Unified Intelligence / HIL v1.9; core [C,I,O,T,H,SA], DI from T×H×p, M supporting
principles: Memory Capability M is independently measured as a supporting coordinate, not a sixth conceptual intelligence family.
I_n certification requires M>=mu_n, but the converse does not hold; memory may exceed Individual Intelligence.
M is excluded from the default HLIS dimension set to avoid double counting with I.
GUI perception GP remains a C subscale; P_vis remains a T descriptor; end-to-end computer use remains DI.
Higher I/O/M open-ended levels require longitudinal sealed external evaluation.
A level whose definition denies a pre-written answer cannot be certified by a static exact-match item.
changes_from_v1_1: audit_items.py added; against v1.1 unchanged it reports 45 errors, recorded in docs/AUDIT_v1_1.md
causal_reasoning shipped 32 items with ONE distinct payload, filed at all eight levels C0-COmega; three more C families collapsed nearly as far
four C families regenerated from tools/c_ladder.py, which COMPUTES every key; all 80 cells distinct and each level asks a different question
68 static exact-match items at discovery and open-ended levels downgraded to specification-only/protocol
audit recomputes every key it can and fails the build on disagreement
known_limitations: no runnable evidence for C5 and above remains in this library; those levels need sealed longitudinal protocols
key recomputation covers only the four families that ship a reference; ~1150 items still have asserted keys that nothing has checked
the audit is a filter with unknown recall; unflagged items are unaudited, not validated
payload comparison is exact-identity, so two items differing only in a variable name are not flagged
